name: ghar-search
description: Ghar Search dual-app root orchestration workspace

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,landing -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:landing"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:landing
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,landing -c blue,green "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:landing"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:landing
